attempts.exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original adult humanoid FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE, source-only proposed concept for a miniature cohort.
Primary request: a single original middle-aged male spymaster of heavy solid build, approximately in his fifties, with a bald crown, close-cropped dark side hair, an intelligent weathered face, and a calm observant expression. Invent his face; do not depict an actor or reproduce any existing game's character model, screen, costume or key art.
Reference handling: the previously inspected Philippa front reference informs only cohort finish, subdued jewel-color richness and material readability; the Medusa quality reference informs only sculptural detail and polished miniature concept quality. Do not copy either woman's identity, anatomy, costume, props, ornament or pose.
Scene/backdrop: completely plain uniform charcoal background, no floor or ground scene, no cast shadow outside the pedestal.
Subject and costume: one adult man, broad torso and sturdy legs, dark teal quilted SHORT doublet with a simple front closure over practical brown trousers, plain broad brown leather belt, plain calf-high leather boots. Bare bald crown, no headgear. His LEFT hand (on image RIGHT) visibly holds a small CLOSED unmarked leather folio at his left side. His RIGHT hand (on image LEFT) is relaxed and EMPTY. No weaponry.
Pose: relaxed standing, both knees straight, both feet planted and facing directly forward. Both elbows gently but clearly bent and held away from the torso. Clear continuous charcoal-background gaps separate each arm from the torso; another visible gap separates the legs. Hands fully visible and anatomically coherent, natural five-digit hands, ungloved, no crossed arms and no hands hidden behind the folio or body. The left fingers and thumb visibly grasp the edge of the folio while the folio stays outside the torso silhouette.
Style/medium: highly finished original fantasy miniature design, realistic anatomy with readable sculptural forms, finely quilted fabric, matte practical leather and weathered skin, clean controlled studio rendering. Plain functional costume, no flamboyant decoration.
Composition/framing: portrait canvas. STRICT FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC technical view: camera exactly level, zero elevation or pitch, zero yaw or roll; head, chest, pelvis, knees and boots square to the viewer. No three-quarter view, no perspective convergence. Entire figure, entire head and entire pedestal visible. Top of the bald crown at y=6% of canvas height, pedestal BOTTOM at y=90%, generous side margins, centered composition. Keep all fingers and folio in frame.
Pedestal: exactly ONE round DARK STONE pedestal composed of TWO shallow stacked circular discs. View the circular discs EXACTLY EDGE-ON from the front at zero pitch. Show only two straight horizontal stone sidewall bands and the single straight seam between them. The pedestal top is completely INVISIBLE: no visible top surface, no oval, no ellipse, no bevel that reveals a horizontal top plane. Flat horizontal upper and lower silhouettes. This is one two-disc pedestal, not two separate bases.
Lighting/mood: soft balanced studio lighting that shows both hands and dark clothing clearly, modest highlights on leather and skin, no dramatic directional color casts.
Constraints: only this one character, his small closed folio, and the single edge-on two-disc pedestal on charcoal. No VFX, aura, smoke, magic, glow, scenic ground, other objects, text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, UI, contact sheet, inset or second view. Preserve the original heavy middle-aged human male identity and practical teal-and-brown clothing.
attempts.decision: Not selected: crown too close to top.

Keep unchanged: strict FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC orientation, level zero-pitch camera, frontal face and torso; both elbow gaps, leg gap, and anatomically coherent fully visible hands; only one two-disc round dark-stone pedestal seen EXACTLY EDGE-ON, with invisible top surface and two straight horizontal sidewall bands separated by one seam. Background: plain charcoal, no VFX, no ground scene, no new props, no text, labels, watermark or UI.
Change only overall framing; no identity, costume, pose, hand or pedestal redesign.
attempts.decision: Selected as proposed/source-only: more head clearance; remaining base-position error disclosed.

design_interpretation: Adult heavy middle-aged spymaster; original invented face and practical teal/brown clothing, leather folio. Appearance choices are authorized design interpretation and are not inferred from health/movement/melee statistics.
limitations: Remaining exact framing deviation is recorded in verification.json.
Originality is an instruction and design intent; no exhaustive likeness/IP similarity audit was performed.
Single raster front source only; no back/side, mesh, rig, animation, engine integration or game readiness.
